critique.evidence: The screen strongly advances the intent-integrity story through adaptive red-team mutations, training-fold attack reduction from 4% to 0%, fraud phylogeny, surviving attack classes, guarded vaccination, regression gates, a human promotion boundary, and an explicit “live unchanged” safeguard. Payment relevance is suggested by fraud and known-payee reuse. However, the screen itself warns that 0% replay is only a training-fold floor and claims a separate fresh-row regression panel without visibly presenting that result. It also lacks an explicit Mastercard/payment-rail outcome or business-impact measure, so the core defense generalization and brief linkage are not fully proven.
critique.fix: Add a clearly labeled fresh-row/holdout results panel with baseline-versus-defended attack success, benign-traffic false positives, calibration, confidence/sample size, and promotion decision. Tie those outcomes to a concrete Mastercard payment scenario and measurable fraud-loss or authorization impact while preserving the live-model isolation proof.
